project_identity.design_archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Earthy Hybrid (Deep Obsidian Green, Emerald Glow, Amber Gold)
project_identity.core_motto: One explainable, risk-adjusted selling decision per lot with verifiable proof & confidence bands

font_rules.data_and_chips: JetBrains Mono, monospace (High precision for prices, P10/P90 bands, timestamps)

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: High Density Tactical Grid (Mode B for Dashboards)
layout_and_spacing.responsive_rules: Desktop-first demo surface with seamless mobile stack collapse. Primary CTA anchored visually on every step.

source_chip.description: Every number MUST carry a source chip indicating data origin
source_chip.style: bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-mono inline-flex items-center gap-1

confidence_and_p10_p90_band.description: P10 (pessimistic), P50 (expected), P90 (optimistic) confidence ranges must be visually distinct
confidence_and_p10_p90_band.style: bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/20 p-3 rounded-lg font-mono text-xs text-emerald-200
confidence_and_p10_p90_band.badge_style: px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 font-bold

recommendation_hero_card.description: The single dominant action hero card on the decision screen
recommendation_hero_card.style: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-950/80 via-emerald-900/40 to-slate-900 border-2 border-emerald-500/50 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)] p-6 rounded-xl

money_meter_outcome_ledger.description: Shows baseline vs realized revenue comparison with live audit logs

interactive_demo_flow: 1. Dashboard: Nashik Onion real Agmarknet prices + P10/P50/P90 forecast chart + Freshness alert banner + FPO aggregation card
2. 'What Should I Do?' Form: Inputs for Lot size (quintals), Crop quality, Location (Lasalgaon/Pimplegaon), Moisture %
3. Decision Card & 5-Pathway NRV Comparison: Hero recommendation card + NRV breakdown table + Why evidence bullets + What-if sliders
4. Create Lot & Simulated Bids: Live incoming offers (Traders, FPOs, Retail Chains) with Trust Score badges
5. Accept Offer & Logistics Timeline: Booking stub, vehicle dispatch tracker, payment Escrow status
6. Money Meter & Outcome Ledger: Delta revenue added (+₹8,400 over Mandi baseline) + Immutable audit log
7. Market Pulse Map: MapLibre interactive district map (Surplus / Balanced / Shortage zones)
8. Govt / MSAMB Read-Only Console: Market arrivals, price caps, model backtest MAPE metrics (MAPE: 4.2%)
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: All interactive elements MUST contain data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='decision-form-submit-button').
Keep the V0.1 look: deep emerald green background (#05130d), cards (#0f2b20), and one clear primary recommendation hero card.
Every single price/cost/forecast number MUST feature a visible Source Chip (e.g., [Agmarknet 2026-09-06] or [Simulated Model]).
Confidence intervals and P10-P50-P90 bands MUST be present on price charts and NRV pathway recommendations.
Ensure ONE primary action button per screen to maintain cognitive clarity for the farmer user.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, sticky headers, or floating panels. Use solid dark green or heavy backdrop blur.
Use JetBrains Mono or Outfit for data numbers and headers; NEVER use Space Grotesk.
Include sample data preloaded for Nashik Onion lot (300 Quintals, Grade A, Lasalgaon Mandi) with instant toggle for Tomato second crop.
